name: scotland
description: Plan and check Scottish walks and stargazing: which Walkhighlands walks fit the weather and where the night sky will be dark and clear, each with a go, marginal or no verdict and its reason.

interface.longDescription: Plan and check walks and stargazing anywhere in Scotland. Ask where to walk near a place over the next few days, whether a named Walkhighlands walk is on for a given day and which other days suit it, or where and when the night sky will be dark and clear. Each walk and night comes with a go, marginal or no verdict and a one-line reason, the start window or clear window, sunrise, sunset and the moon. For anyone planning a day out or a trip in Scotland. Limits: Scotland only; the hourly forecast reaches about two and a half days ahead, so later days come back as unknown; walk weather is forecast at the walk's start, and summits are usually colder and windier; routes and descriptions stay on Walkhighlands, linked from each walk.
defaultPrompt: Which walks near Aviemore suit the weather this weekend?
Is Ben Nevis on for Saturday, and if not, which day is better?
Where is the best stargazing near Inverness this week?
